newsitem.title: USA: NBC to offer affiliates access to Web page.
newsitem.headline: NBC to offer affiliates access to Web page.

text.p: The NBC television network said Tuesday it is developing a Web page for its television affiliates around the United States.
The service is called "NBC Interactive Neighborhood," or "NBC-IN," said NBC, a unit of General Electric Co.
Participating affiliates would be able to use the network's master Web page to plug in local news feeds amidst the network's own national and international coverage.

An NBC spokeswoman said the affiliates are being approached now to sign up. Computer users would access Interactive Neighborhood for their area by typing in the Internet address of their local station.
"NBC-IN is an example of how NBC stations can engage new technology to extend the role of their broadcast franchise," said Marty Yudkovitz, the president of NBC's Interactive unit.
